pillar: 3 — Customers and audience (owns buyer groups and the quote bank) · 8 — Outbound (list mode: build, score, watch)
intents: Who is my customer / who are our buyers?
Voice of customer — mine our reviews; what words do customers use?
Why do people buy us or leave?
Where does our audience hang out?
Find me 50 right-fit people with emails (list mode)
Build a prospect or ABM list; find retail buyers or distributors (list mode)
Score these leads / which inbound leads do we answer first? (list mode)
Who's looking for an alternative to <rival>? (list mode, switch intent)
Tell me when a past champion changes jobs / when target accounts start hiring (list mode, watch)
reads: the brand's own customer data, asked for once up front when it has customers: customer or order export, cancel reasons, win/loss notes, support themes (counts and patterns only reach the brain)
brand brain: summary, kit audience text, products, competitors, organic, learnings (learn-my-brand); customer evidence via knowledge_search
workspace research/market/ — latest market report (research-market): its market figures are context, group sizes are counted here; read for consistency
workspace research/competitors/ — rival records and report (research-competitors): read for consistency
workspace research/audience/ — buyer groups, quote bank, last report, group notes, ledger (this playbook, earlier runs); research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md (spend-gate)
claims via claims-gate (learn-my-brand) — for messages and proof lines
human-supplied (list mode): exclusions export, email-checker results, outreach outcomes
human-supplied (list mode): a list to score (sign-ups, demo requests, webinar or event attendees they collected), a champions list, a target-account list for watches
public sources (list mode): Hacker News search API, public GitHub API, event speaker and sponsor pages, rivals' customer pages
writes: local gooseworks-reports/<brand-slug>/<date>-audience.md and workspace research/audience/<date>-report.md → 'Audience report — <Brand> — <date>' (keep-history) via write-report and save-to-brain — read by the marketer, the next run, research-market and research-competitors

workspace research/audience/buyer-groups.md → 'Buyer groups — <Brand> — <date>' (supersede) — the one list of buyer groups; read by research-market, plan-campaign, make-content, run-organic-social, the ad and video makers, work-with-creators, list mode

workspace research/audience/voc-bank.md → 'Voice-of-customer bank — <Brand> — <date>' (supersede) and voc-bank.jsonl (not imported) — the quote bank; read by the ad and video makers, make-content, run-organic-social, research-competitors, plan-campaign
brand audience field: ranked buyer-group summary proposed via brand_update (knowledge.audience, agent_proposal) — skipped when the lead is provisional
workspace research/audience/segments/<slug>.md — read by the next run
research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md rows — read by every playbook's spend estimates

list mode: local gooseworks-reports/<brand-slug>/<date>-list.md + <date>-list.csv; workspace research/audience/<date>-<list>/report.md → 'Prospect list report — <Brand> — <date>' (keep-history, no people's data), list.csv, segments.csv, catch-all.csv, dropped.csv (not imported); research/audience/ledger.csv via outcomes-ledger — read by write-outreach, the marketer's outreach tool and later runs
research/audience/fit-definition.md — read by list mode, score-a-list and write-outreach
watches: research/audience/watch/champions.csv, accounts.csv (not imported), watch/<date>.md — read by the scheduled watch and the marketer
